title: P2: random.seed(42) pollutes global random state on every request
description:
File: python/src/lichen/dashboard/app.py
Line: 316-317

Bug: The `partial_topology_data()` handler calls `random.seed(42)` inside the function body when generating fallback mock data. This reseeds the global `random` module on every request when no simulator data is available.

Impact:
- Makes all subsequent `random` calls predictable after this endpoint is hit
- Could cause subtle reproducibility bugs in other parts of the application using `random`
- If `random` is used for anything security-adjacent elsewhere, this weakens it

Fix: Use a local Random instance instead of reseeding the global:
```python
rng = random.Random(42)
mock = [
    {
        "id": f"n{i}",
        "x": rng.uniform(0, 800),
        "y": rng.uniform(0, 380),
        ...
    }
    ...
]
```
